Q1a.en: An equivalence relation on the set \(A = \{1, 2, 3\}\) that contains \((1, 2)\) must be reflexive, so it contains \((1, 1), (2, 2), (3, 3)\), and symmetric, so it also contains \((2, 1)\). The smallest such relation is \(R_1 = \{(1, 1), (2, 2), (3, 3), (1, 2), (2, 1)\}\), which is also transitive. If any further pair, say \((2, 3)\), is added, symmetry and transitivity force \((3, 2), (1, 3), (3, 1)\) as well, which gives the universal relation \(R_2 = A \times A\). So there are exactly two such equivalence relations, which is the choice 2.
Q1a.hi: समुच्चय \(A = \{1, 2, 3\}\) पर अवयव \((1, 2)\) वाला तुल्यता संबंध स्वतुल्य होना चाहिए, अतः उसमें \((1, 1), (2, 2), (3, 3)\) होंगे, और सममित होना चाहिए, अतः उसमें \((2, 1)\) भी होगा। ऐसा सबसे छोटा संबंध \(R_1 = \{(1, 1), (2, 2), (3, 3), (1, 2), (2, 1)\}\) है, जो संक्रामक भी है। इसमें कोई और युग्म, जैसे \((2, 3)\), जोड़ने पर सममिति और संक्रामकता के कारण \((3, 2), (1, 3), (3, 1)\) भी जोड़ने पड़ते हैं, जिससे सार्वत्रिक संबंध \(R_2 = A \times A\) प्राप्त होता है। अतः ऐसे तुल्यता संबंध केवल दो हैं, जो विकल्प 2 है।

Q1b.en: For \(x_1, x_2 \in Z\), \(f(x_1) = f(x_2) \Rightarrow x_1^3 = x_2^3 \Rightarrow x_1 = x_2\), so \(f\) is one-one. But \(2 \in Z\) has no preimage, because no integer has cube 2. So \(f\) is one-one but not onto, which is the choice "One one but not onto".
Q1b.hi: \(x_1, x_2 \in Z\) के लिए \(f(x_1) = f(x_2) \Rightarrow x_1^3 = x_2^3 \Rightarrow x_1 = x_2\), अतः \(f\) एकैकी है। परंतु \(2 \in Z\) का कोई पूर्व प्रतिबिंब नहीं है, क्योंकि किसी भी पूर्णांक का घन 2 नहीं होता। अतः \(f\) एकैकी है परंतु आच्छादी नहीं, जो विकल्प "एकैकी परंतु आच्छादी नहीं" है।

Q1c.en: Let \(\tan^{-1}x = \theta\), so \(\tan\theta = x\) with \(\theta \in \left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\), where \(\cos\theta > 0\). Then \(\sin\theta = \frac{\tan\theta}{\sec\theta} = \frac{\tan\theta}{\sqrt{1 + \tan^2\theta}} = \frac{x}{\sqrt{1 + x^2}}\). So \(\sin(\tan^{-1}x) = \frac{x}{\sqrt{1 + x^2}}\), which is the choice \(\frac{x}{\sqrt{1+x^2}}\).
Q1c.hi: माना \(\tan^{-1}x = \theta\), तब \(\tan\theta = x\) तथा \(\theta \in \left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\), जहाँ \(\cos\theta > 0\) है। अतः \(\sin\theta = \frac{\tan\theta}{\sec\theta} = \frac{\tan\theta}{\sqrt{1 + \tan^2\theta}} = \frac{x}{\sqrt{1 + x^2}}\)। इस प्रकार \(\sin(\tan^{-1}x) = \frac{x}{\sqrt{1 + x^2}}\), जो विकल्प \(\frac{x}{\sqrt{1+x^2}}\) है।

Q1d.en: A matrix is a square matrix when its number of rows equals its number of columns. The matrix \([a_{ij}]_{m \times n}\) has \(m\) rows and \(n\) columns, so it is square when \(m = n\), which is the choice \(m = n\).
Q1d.hi: जिस आव्यूह में पंक्तियों की संख्या स्तंभों की संख्या के बराबर हो, वह वर्ग आव्यूह कहलाता है। आव्यूह \([a_{ij}]_{m \times n}\) में \(m\) पंक्तियाँ तथा \(n\) स्तंभ हैं, अतः यह वर्ग आव्यूह है यदि \(m = n\), जो विकल्प \(m = n\) है।

Q1e.en:
Integrating by parts with \(x\) as the first function and \(\cos x\) as the second:
\(\int x \cos x \, dx = x \sin x - \int 1 \cdot \sin x \, dx = x \sin x + \cos x + c\).
This is the choice \(\cos x + x \sin x + c\).
Q1e.hi:
\(x\) को प्रथम फलन तथा \(\cos x\) को द्वितीय फलन लेकर खंडशः समाकलन करने पर:
\(\int x \cos x \, dx = x \sin x - \int 1 \cdot \sin x \, dx = x \sin x + \cos x + c\)।
यह विकल्प \(\cos x + x \sin x + c\) है।

Q2a.en:
\(\int_{-1}^{1} (x + 1) \, dx = \left[\frac{x^2}{2} + x\right]_{-1}^{1} = \left(\frac{1}{2} + 1\right) - \left(\frac{1}{2} - 1\right) = \frac{3}{2} + \frac{1}{2} = 2\).
So the value is 2.

Q2b.en:
Dividing by \(x\), the equation becomes \(\frac{dy}{dx} + \frac{2}{x}y = x\), which is of the form \(\frac{dy}{dx} + Py = Q\) with \(P = \frac{2}{x}\).
So I.F. \(= e^{\int \frac{2}{x} dx} = e^{2\log x} = e^{\log x^2} = x^2\).
Q2b.hi:
\(x\) से भाग देने पर समीकरण \(\frac{dy}{dx} + \frac{2}{x}y = x\) हो जाता है, जो \(\frac{dy}{dx} + Py = Q\) के रूप का है, जहाँ \(P = \frac{2}{x}\)।
अतः I.F. \(= e^{\int \frac{2}{x} dx} = e^{2\log x} = e^{\log x^2} = x^2\)।

Q2c.en:
The projection of \(\vec{a} = \hat{i} - \hat{j}\) on \(\vec{b} = \hat{i} + \hat{j}\) is \(\frac{\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}}{|\vec{b}|} = \frac{(1)(1) + (-1)(1)}{\sqrt{1^2 + 1^2}} = \frac{0}{\sqrt{2}} = 0\).
So the projection is 0 (the two vectors are perpendicular).
Q2c.hi:
सदिश \(\vec{b} = \hat{i} + \hat{j}\) पर सदिश \(\vec{a} = \hat{i} - \hat{j}\) का प्रक्षेप \(\frac{\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}}{|\vec{b}|} = \frac{(1)(1) + (-1)(1)}{\sqrt{1^2 + 1^2}} = \frac{0}{\sqrt{2}} = 0\) है।
अतः प्रक्षेप 0 है (दोनों सदिश परस्पर लम्बवत हैं)।

Q2d.en:
By definition \(P(A/B) = \frac{P(A \cap B)}{P(B)}\). The question gives only \(P(A)\) and \(P(B)\); it gives neither \(P(A \cap B)\) nor says that the events are independent, so as printed the value of \(P(A/B)\) cannot be found.
If the events \(A\) and \(B\) are taken as independent, then \(P(A \cap B) = P(A) \cdot P(B) = \frac{1}{2} \times \frac{1}{3} = \frac{1}{6}\), and \(P(A/B) = \frac{1/6}{1/3} = \frac{1}{2}\), which equals \(P(A)\).
Q2d.hi:
परिभाषा से \(P(A/B) = \frac{P(A \cap B)}{P(B)}\)। प्रश्न में केवल \(P(A)\) तथा \(P(B)\) दिए हैं; न तो \(P(A \cap B)\) दिया है और न ही यह कहा गया है कि घटनाएँ स्वतंत्र हैं, अतः छपे हुए रूप में \(P(A/B)\) का मान ज्ञात नहीं किया जा सकता।
यदि घटनाओं \(A\) तथा \(B\) को स्वतंत्र मान लिया जाए, तो \(P(A \cap B) = P(A) \cdot P(B) = \frac{1}{2} \times \frac{1}{3} = \frac{1}{6}\) तथा \(P(A/B) = \frac{1/6}{1/3} = \frac{1}{2}\), जो \(P(A)\) के बराबर है।

Q2e.en: The set \(X\) has 3 elements and \(Y\) has 2. Each of the 3 elements of \(X\) can be sent to either of the 2 elements of \(Y\), independently, so the number of functions from \(X\) to \(Y\) is \(2 \times 2 \times 2 = 2^3 = 8\).
Q2e.hi: समुच्चय \(X\) में 3 अवयव तथा \(Y\) में 2 अवयव हैं। \(X\) के प्रत्येक अवयव का प्रतिबिंब \(Y\) के 2 अवयवों में से कोई भी हो सकता है, अतः \(X\) से \(Y\) तक फलनों की संख्या \(2 \times 2 \times 2 = 2^3 = 8\) है।

Q3a.en:
Put \(x = a\sin\theta\). Since \(|x| < a\), \(\theta = \sin^{-1}\frac{x}{a} \in \left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\), where \(\cos\theta > 0\).
Then \(\sqrt{a^2 - x^2} = \sqrt{a^2 - a^2\sin^2\theta} = a\cos\theta\), so
\(\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{x}{\sqrt{a^2 - x^2}}\right) = \tan^{-1}\left(\frac{a\sin\theta}{a\cos\theta}\right) = \tan^{-1}(\tan\theta) = \theta = \sin^{-1}\frac{x}{a}\).
The simplest form is \(\sin^{-1}\frac{x}{a}\).
Q3a.hi:
माना \(x = a\sin\theta\)। चूँकि \(|x| < a\), अतः \(\theta = \sin^{-1}\frac{x}{a} \in \left(-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\), जहाँ \(\cos\theta > 0\)।
तब \(\sqrt{a^2 - x^2} = \sqrt{a^2 - a^2\sin^2\theta} = a\cos\theta\), अतः
\(\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{x}{\sqrt{a^2 - x^2}}\right) = \tan^{-1}\left(\frac{a\sin\theta}{a\cos\theta}\right) = \tan^{-1}(\tan\theta) = \theta = \sin^{-1}\frac{x}{a}\)।
सरलतम रूप \(\sin^{-1}\frac{x}{a}\) है।

Q3c.en:
Let \(x = \cos\theta\), so \(\theta = \cos^{-1}x\). Since \(x \in \left[\frac{1}{2}, 1\right]\), \(\theta \in \left[0, \frac{\pi}{3}\right]\), and hence \(3\theta \in [0, \pi]\).
Now \(4x^3 - 3x = 4\cos^3\theta - 3\cos\theta = \cos 3\theta\).
So \(\cos^{-1}(4x^3 - 3x) = \cos^{-1}(\cos 3\theta) = 3\theta\), because \(3\theta\) lies in \([0, \pi]\), the principal value range of \(\cos^{-1}\).
Therefore \(\cos^{-1}(4x^3 - 3x) = 3\cos^{-1}x\). Hence proved.
Q3c.hi:
माना \(x = \cos\theta\), तब \(\theta = \cos^{-1}x\)। चूँकि \(x \in \left[\frac{1}{2}, 1\right]\), अतः \(\theta \in \left[0, \frac{\pi}{3}\right]\) और इसलिए \(3\theta \in [0, \pi]\)।
अब \(4x^3 - 3x = 4\cos^3\theta - 3\cos\theta = \cos 3\theta\)।
अतः \(\cos^{-1}(4x^3 - 3x) = \cos^{-1}(\cos 3\theta) = 3\theta\), क्योंकि \(3\theta\), \(\cos^{-1}\) के मुख्य मान परिसर \([0, \pi]\) में है।
इस प्रकार \(\cos^{-1}(4x^3 - 3x) = 3\cos^{-1}x\)। इति सिद्धम्।

Q3d.en:
Let \(u = \sin^2 x\) and \(v = e^{\cos x}\). We need \(\frac{du}{dv}\).
\(\frac{du}{dx} = 2\sin x \cos x\) and \(\frac{dv}{dx} = e^{\cos x} \cdot (-\sin x) = -\sin x \, e^{\cos x}\).
So \(\frac{du}{dv} = \frac{du/dx}{dv/dx} = \frac{2\sin x \cos x}{-\sin x \, e^{\cos x}} = -\frac{2\cos x}{e^{\cos x}} = -2\cos x \, e^{-\cos x}\) (where \(\sin x \neq 0\)).
Q3d.hi:
माना \(u = \sin^2 x\) तथा \(v = e^{\cos x}\)। हमें \(\frac{du}{dv}\) ज्ञात करना है।
\(\frac{du}{dx} = 2\sin x \cos x\) तथा \(\frac{dv}{dx} = e^{\cos x} \cdot (-\sin x) = -\sin x \, e^{\cos x}\)।
अतः \(\frac{du}{dv} = \frac{du/dx}{dv/dx} = \frac{2\sin x \cos x}{-\sin x \, e^{\cos x}} = -\frac{2\cos x}{e^{\cos x}} = -2\cos x \, e^{-\cos x}\) (जहाँ \(\sin x \neq 0\))।

Q4a.en:
Here \(f(x) = 3x + 17\), so \(f'(x) = 3 > 0\) for every \(x \in R\).
Since the derivative is positive throughout \(R\), \(f\) is strictly increasing on \(R\).
(Equivalently, for any \(x_1 < x_2\) in \(R\): \(3x_1 < 3x_2 \Rightarrow 3x_1 + 17 < 3x_2 + 17 \Rightarrow f(x_1) < f(x_2)\).) Hence proved.
Q4a.hi:
यहाँ \(f(x) = 3x + 17\), अतः प्रत्येक \(x \in R\) के लिए \(f'(x) = 3 > 0\)।
चूँकि सम्पूर्ण \(R\) पर अवकलज धनात्मक है, अतः \(f\), \(R\) पर निरंतर वर्धमान है।
(अथवा, \(R\) में किन्हीं \(x_1 < x_2\) के लिए: \(3x_1 < 3x_2 \Rightarrow 3x_1 + 17 < 3x_2 + 17 \Rightarrow f(x_1) < f(x_2)\)।) इति सिद्धम्।

Q4b.en:
By definition, \((fog)(x) = f(g(x))\).
So \((fog)(x) = f(3x^3) = \cos(3x^3)\) for every \(x \in R\).
Q4b.hi:
परिभाषा से \((fog)(x) = f(g(x))\)।
अतः प्रत्येक \(x \in R\) के लिए \((fog)(x) = f(3x^3) = \cos(3x^3)\)।

Q4c.en:
Separating the variables, \(\frac{dy}{1 + y^2} = \frac{dx}{1 + x^2}\).
Integrating both sides: \(\int \frac{dy}{1 + y^2} = \int \frac{dx}{1 + x^2}\), so \(\tan^{-1}y = \tan^{-1}x + C\).
The general solution is \(\tan^{-1}y = \tan^{-1}x + C\), where \(C\) is an arbitrary constant.
Q4c.hi:
चरों को पृथक करने पर \(\frac{dy}{1 + y^2} = \frac{dx}{1 + x^2}\)।
दोनों पक्षों का समाकलन करने पर: \(\int \frac{dy}{1 + y^2} = \int \frac{dx}{1 + x^2}\), अतः \(\tan^{-1}y = \tan^{-1}x + C\)।
अभीष्ट व्यापक हल \(\tan^{-1}y = \tan^{-1}x + C\) है, जहाँ \(C\) एक स्वेच्छ अचर है।

Q4d.en:
Let \(|\vec{a}| = |\vec{b}| = k\). Then \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = |\vec{a}||\vec{b}|\cos 60^\circ = k \cdot k \cdot \frac{1}{2} = \frac{k^2}{2}\).
Given \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = \frac{1}{2}\), so \(\frac{k^2}{2} = \frac{1}{2}\), which gives \(k^2 = 1\) and \(k = 1\).
So \(|\vec{a}| = |\vec{b}| = 1\).
Q4d.hi:
माना \(|\vec{a}| = |\vec{b}| = k\)। तब \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = |\vec{a}||\vec{b}|\cos 60^\circ = k \cdot k \cdot \frac{1}{2} = \frac{k^2}{2}\)।
दिया है \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = \frac{1}{2}\), अतः \(\frac{k^2}{2} = \frac{1}{2}\), जिससे \(k^2 = 1\) तथा \(k = 1\)।
अतः \(|\vec{a}| = |\vec{b}| = 1\)।

Q5a.en:
Comparing with \(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_1 + \lambda\vec{b}\) and \(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_2 + \mu\vec{b}\):
\(\vec{a}_1 = \hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 4\hat{k}\), \(\vec{a}_2 = 3\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} - 5\hat{k}\), \(\vec{b} = 2\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 6\hat{k}\).
Both lines have the same direction vector \(\vec{b}\), so they are parallel. The shortest distance between parallel lines is
\(d = \frac{|\vec{b} \times (\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1)|}{|\vec{b}|}\).
Now \(\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1 = 2\hat{i} + \hat{j} - \hat{k}\) and
\(\vec{b} \times (\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1) = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 2 & 3 & 6 \\ 2 & 1 & -1 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(-3 - 6) - \hat{j}(-2 - 12) + \hat{k}(2 - 6) = -9\hat{i} + 14\hat{j} - 4\hat{k}\).
Its magnitude is \(\sqrt{81 + 196 + 16} = \sqrt{293}\), and \(|\vec{b}| = \sqrt{4 + 9 + 36} = 7\).
So \(d = \frac{\sqrt{293}}{7}\) units.
Q5a.hi:
\(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_1 + \lambda\vec{b}\) तथा \(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_2 + \mu\vec{b}\) से तुलना करने पर:
\(\vec{a}_1 = \hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 4\hat{k}\), \(\vec{a}_2 = 3\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} - 5\hat{k}\), \(\vec{b} = 2\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 6\hat{k}\)।
दोनों रेखाओं का दिशा सदिश \(\vec{b}\) एक ही है, अतः रेखाएँ समांतर हैं। समांतर रेखाओं के बीच न्यूनतम दूरी
\(d = \frac{|\vec{b} \times (\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1)|}{|\vec{b}|}\)।
अब \(\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1 = 2\hat{i} + \hat{j} - \hat{k}\) तथा
\(\vec{b} \times (\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1) = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 2 & 3 & 6 \\ 2 & 1 & -1 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(-3 - 6) - \hat{j}(-2 - 12) + \hat{k}(2 - 6) = -9\hat{i} + 14\hat{j} - 4\hat{k}\)।
इसका परिमाण \(\sqrt{81 + 196 + 16} = \sqrt{293}\) है, तथा \(|\vec{b}| = \sqrt{4 + 9 + 36} = 7\)।
अतः \(d = \frac{\sqrt{293}}{7}\) इकाई।

Q5b.en:
From \(\log\left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right) = 3x + 4y\), we get \(\frac{dy}{dx} = e^{3x + 4y} = e^{3x} \cdot e^{4y}\).
Separating the variables: \(e^{-4y} \, dy = e^{3x} \, dx\).
Integrating both sides: \(\int e^{-4y} \, dy = \int e^{3x} \, dx\), so \(\frac{e^{-4y}}{-4} = \frac{e^{3x}}{3} + C\).
Multiplying by 12: \(-3e^{-4y} = 4e^{3x} + 12C\), that is \(4e^{3x} + 3e^{-4y} + 12C = 0\).
The general solution is \(4e^{3x} + 3e^{-4y} + 12C = 0\), where \(C\) is an arbitrary constant.
Q5b.hi:
\(\log\left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right) = 3x + 4y\) से \(\frac{dy}{dx} = e^{3x + 4y} = e^{3x} \cdot e^{4y}\)।
चरों को पृथक करने पर: \(e^{-4y} \, dy = e^{3x} \, dx\)।
दोनों पक्षों का समाकलन करने पर: \(\int e^{-4y} \, dy = \int e^{3x} \, dx\), अतः \(\frac{e^{-4y}}{-4} = \frac{e^{3x}}{3} + C\)।
12 से गुणा करने पर: \(-3e^{-4y} = 4e^{3x} + 12C\), अर्थात् \(4e^{3x} + 3e^{-4y} + 12C = 0\)।
अभीष्ट व्यापक हल \(4e^{3x} + 3e^{-4y} + 12C = 0\) है, जहाँ \(C\) एक स्वेच्छ अचर है।

Q5c.en:
The direction ratios of the line through \((1, -1, 2)\) and \((3, 4, -2)\) are \(a_1 = 3 - 1 = 2\), \(b_1 = 4 - (-1) = 5\), \(c_1 = -2 - 2 = -4\).
The direction ratios of the line through \((0, 3, 2)\) and \((3, 5, 6)\) are \(a_2 = 3 - 0 = 3\), \(b_2 = 5 - 3 = 2\), \(c_2 = 6 - 2 = 4\).
Two lines are perpendicular if \(a_1a_2 + b_1b_2 + c_1c_2 = 0\). Here
\(a_1a_2 + b_1b_2 + c_1c_2 = (2)(3) + (5)(2) + (-4)(4) = 6 + 10 - 16 = 0\).
Hence the two lines are perpendicular.

Q5d.en:
First find \(A^2\):
\(A^2 = \begin{bmatrix} 3 & -2 \\ 4 & -2 \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} 3 & -2 \\ 4 & -2 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 9 - 8 & -6 + 4 \\ 12 - 8 & -8 + 4 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & -2 \\ 4 & -4 \end{bmatrix}\).
Next, \(KA - 2I = \begin{bmatrix} 3K & -2K \\ 4K & -2K \end{bmatrix} - \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 3K - 2 & -2K \\ 4K & -2K - 2 \end{bmatrix}\).
Since \(A^2 = KA - 2I\), equating corresponding elements:
\(3K - 2 = 1\), \(-2K = -2\), \(4K = 4\), \(-2K - 2 = -4\).
Every one of these gives \(K = 1\). So \(K = 1\).
Q5d.hi:
पहले \(A^2\) ज्ञात करते हैं:
\(A^2 = \begin{bmatrix} 3 & -2 \\ 4 & -2 \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} 3 & -2 \\ 4 & -2 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 9 - 8 & -6 + 4 \\ 12 - 8 & -8 + 4 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & -2 \\ 4 & -4 \end{bmatrix}\)।
अब \(KA - 2I = \begin{bmatrix} 3K & -2K \\ 4K & -2K \end{bmatrix} - \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 3K - 2 & -2K \\ 4K & -2K - 2 \end{bmatrix}\)।
चूँकि \(A^2 = KA - 2I\), संगत अवयवों की तुलना करने पर:
\(3K - 2 = 1\), \(-2K = -2\), \(4K = 4\), \(-2K - 2 = -4\)।
इन सभी से \(K = 1\) प्राप्त होता है। अतः \(K = 1\)।

Q5e.en:
For \(x \neq 0\), \(f(x) = x^2 \sin\frac{1}{x}\) is the product of the polynomial \(x^2\) and \(\sin\frac{1}{x}\), a composition of continuous functions; so \(f\) is continuous at every \(x \neq 0\).
At \(x = 0\), \(f(0) = 0\).
Left hand limit: \(\lim_{x \to 0^-} f(x) = \lim_{h \to 0} (0 - h)^2 \sin\left(\frac{1}{0 - h}\right) = \lim_{h \to 0} \left(-h^2 \sin\frac{1}{h}\right) = 0\), since \(h^2 \to 0\) and \(\sin\frac{1}{h}\) stays between \(-1\) and \(1\).
Right hand limit: \(\lim_{x \to 0^+} f(x) = \lim_{h \to 0} (0 + h)^2 \sin\frac{1}{h} = 0\), for the same reason.
(In short, \(-x^2 \leq x^2 \sin\frac{1}{x} \leq x^2\), and both bounds tend to 0.)
So left hand limit \(=\) right hand limit \(= f(0) = 0\), and \(f\) is continuous at \(x = 0\).
Hence \(f\) is continuous at every real number, that is, \(f\) is a continuous function. Hence proved.
Q5e.hi:
\(x \neq 0\) के लिए \(f(x) = x^2 \sin\frac{1}{x}\), बहुपद \(x^2\) तथा \(\sin\frac{1}{x}\) (संतत फलनों का संयोजन) का गुणनफल है; अतः \(f\) प्रत्येक \(x \neq 0\) पर संतत है।
\(x = 0\) पर \(f(0) = 0\)।
बाएँ पक्ष की सीमा: \(\lim_{x \to 0^-} f(x) = \lim_{h \to 0} (0 - h)^2 \sin\left(\frac{1}{0 - h}\right) = \lim_{h \to 0} \left(-h^2 \sin\frac{1}{h}\right) = 0\), क्योंकि \(h^2 \to 0\) तथा \(\sin\frac{1}{h}\) का मान \(-1\) और \(1\) के बीच रहता है।
दाएँ पक्ष की सीमा: \(\lim_{x \to 0^+} f(x) = \lim_{h \to 0} (0 + h)^2 \sin\frac{1}{h} = 0\), इसी कारण से।
(संक्षेप में, \(-x^2 \leq x^2 \sin\frac{1}{x} \leq x^2\), और दोनों सीमाएँ 0 की ओर जाती हैं।)
अतः बाएँ पक्ष की सीमा \(=\) दाएँ पक्ष की सीमा \(= f(0) = 0\), इसलिए \(f\), \(x = 0\) पर संतत है।
इस प्रकार \(f\) प्रत्येक वास्तविक संख्या पर संतत है, अर्थात् \(f\) एक संतत फलन है। इति सिद्धम्।

Q6a.en:
Let \(r\) be the radius and \(S\) the area of the disc at time \(t\). Then \(S = \pi r^2\).
Differentiating with respect to \(t\): \(\frac{dS}{dt} = 2\pi r \frac{dr}{dt}\).
Given \(\frac{dr}{dt} = 0.05\) cm/s, at \(r = 3.2\) cm:
\(\frac{dS}{dt} = 2\pi \times 3.2 \times 0.05 = 0.32\pi\) cm\(^2\)/s.
So the area is increasing at the rate \(0.32\pi\) cm\(^2\)/s (about 1.005 cm\(^2\)/s).
Q6a.hi:
माना समय \(t\) पर डिस्क की त्रिज्या \(r\) तथा क्षेत्रफल \(S\) है। तब \(S = \pi r^2\)।
\(t\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर: \(\frac{dS}{dt} = 2\pi r \frac{dr}{dt}\)।
दिया है \(\frac{dr}{dt} = 0.05\) cm/s, अतः \(r = 3.2\) cm पर:
\(\frac{dS}{dt} = 2\pi \times 3.2 \times 0.05 = 0.32\pi\) cm\(^2\)/s।
अतः क्षेत्रफल \(0.32\pi\) cm\(^2\)/s (लगभग 1.005 cm\(^2\)/s) की दर से बढ़ रहा है।

Q6b.en:
Draw the lines \(x + 2y = 10\) (through \((10, 0)\) and \((0, 5)\)) and \(3x + 4y = 24\) (through \((8, 0)\) and \((0, 6)\)) in the first quadrant (\(x \geq 0, y \geq 0\)).
The constraint \(x + 2y \geq 10\) is satisfied on the side of its line away from the origin, and \(3x + 4y \leq 24\) on the side towards the origin.
The two lines meet where \(x + 2y = 10\) and \(3x + 4y = 24\): doubling the first gives \(2x + 4y = 20\), and subtracting from the second gives \(x = 4\), then \(y = 3\). So they meet at \((4, 3)\).
The feasible region is the triangle with corner points \((0, 5)\), \((4, 3)\) and \((0, 6)\), which is bounded.

| Corner point | \(Z = 200x + 500y\) |
|---|---|
| \((0, 5)\) | 2500 |
| \((4, 3)\) | 2300 (minimum) |
| \((0, 6)\) | 3000 |

So the minimum value of \(Z\) is 2300, at \(x = 4, y = 3\).

Q6c.en:
When a die is thrown twice, the sample space has \(6 \times 6 = 36\) equally likely outcomes.
Let \(F\) be the event that the sum of the numbers is 6: \(F = \{(1, 5), (2, 4), (3, 3), (4, 2), (5, 1)\}\), so \(P(F) = \frac{5}{36}\).
Let \(E\) be the event that 4 appears at least once. Then \(E \cap F = \{(2, 4), (4, 2)\}\), so \(P(E \cap F) = \frac{2}{36}\).
The required conditional probability is
\(P(E/F) = \frac{P(E \cap F)}{P(F)} = \frac{2/36}{5/36} = \frac{2}{5}\).
Q6c.hi:
एक पासे को दो बार उछालने पर प्रतिदर्श समष्टि में \(6 \times 6 = 36\) समसंभाव्य परिणाम होते हैं।
माना \(F\) घटना है कि प्राप्त संख्याओं का योग 6 है: \(F = \{(1, 5), (2, 4), (3, 3), (4, 2), (5, 1)\}\), अतः \(P(F) = \frac{5}{36}\)।
माना \(E\) घटना है कि संख्या 4 कम से कम एक बार प्रकट होती है। तब \(E \cap F = \{(2, 4), (4, 2)\}\), अतः \(P(E \cap F) = \frac{2}{36}\)।
अभीष्ट सप्रतिबंध प्रायिकता
\(P(E/F) = \frac{P(E \cap F)}{P(F)} = \frac{2/36}{5/36} = \frac{2}{5}\)।

Q6d.en:
Let \(|\vec{a}| = |\vec{b}| = |\vec{c}| = k\). Since the vectors are mutually perpendicular, \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} = \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a} = 0\).
Then \(|\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}|^2 = |\vec{a}|^2 + |\vec{b}|^2 + |\vec{c}|^2 + 2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}) = k^2 + k^2 + k^2 + 0 = 3k^2\), so \(|\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}| = \sqrt{3}k\).
Let \(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}\) make angles \(\alpha, \beta, \gamma\) with \(\vec{a}, \vec{b}, \vec{c}\) respectively.
\(\cos\alpha = \frac{(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) \cdot \vec{a}}{|\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}||\vec{a}|} = \frac{|\vec{a}|^2 + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{a} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}}{\sqrt{3}k \cdot k} = \frac{k^2}{\sqrt{3}k^2} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\).
In the same way, \(\cos\beta = \frac{(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) \cdot \vec{b}}{\sqrt{3}k \cdot k} = \frac{k^2}{\sqrt{3}k^2} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\) and \(\cos\gamma = \frac{(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) \cdot \vec{c}}{\sqrt{3}k \cdot k} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\).
So \(\alpha = \beta = \gamma = \cos^{-1}\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\), that is, \(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}\) is equally inclined to \(\vec{a}, \vec{b}\) and \(\vec{c}\). Hence shown.
Q6d.hi:
माना \(|\vec{a}| = |\vec{b}| = |\vec{c}| = k\)। चूँकि सदिश परस्पर लम्बवत हैं, अतः \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} = \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a} = 0\)।
तब \(|\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}|^2 = |\vec{a}|^2 + |\vec{b}|^2 + |\vec{c}|^2 + 2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}) = k^2 + k^2 + k^2 + 0 = 3k^2\), अतः \(|\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}| = \sqrt{3}k\)।
माना सदिश \(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}\), सदिशों \(\vec{a}, \vec{b}, \vec{c}\) के साथ क्रमशः कोण \(\alpha, \beta, \gamma\) बनाता है।
\(\cos\alpha = \frac{(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) \cdot \vec{a}}{|\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}||\vec{a}|} = \frac{|\vec{a}|^2 + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{a} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}}{\sqrt{3}k \cdot k} = \frac{k^2}{\sqrt{3}k^2} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\)।
इसी प्रकार \(\cos\beta = \frac{(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) \cdot \vec{b}}{\sqrt{3}k \cdot k} = \frac{k^2}{\sqrt{3}k^2} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\) तथा \(\cos\gamma = \frac{(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) \cdot \vec{c}}{\sqrt{3}k \cdot k} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\)।
अतः \(\alpha = \beta = \gamma = \cos^{-1}\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\), अर्थात् सदिश \(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}\), सदिशों \(\vec{a}, \vec{b}\) तथा \(\vec{c}\) के साथ बराबर झुका हुआ है। इति सिद्धम्।

Q6e.en:
The circle \(x^2 + y^2 = r^2\) has centre at the origin and radius \(r\), and is symmetric about both axes. So its area is 4 times the area of the part in the first quadrant, bounded by the curve, the \(x\)-axis and the ordinates \(x = 0\) and \(x = r\).
In the first quadrant \(y = \sqrt{r^2 - x^2}\). So
Area \(= 4\int_0^r \sqrt{r^2 - x^2} \, dx = 4\left[\frac{x}{2}\sqrt{r^2 - x^2} + \frac{r^2}{2}\sin^{-1}\frac{x}{r}\right]_0^r\)
\(= 4\left[\left(\frac{r}{2} \cdot 0 + \frac{r^2}{2}\sin^{-1}1\right) - (0 + 0)\right] = 4 \cdot \frac{r^2}{2} \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} = \pi r^2\).
So the area of the circle is \(\pi r^2\) square units.
Q6e.hi:
वृत्त \(x^2 + y^2 = r^2\) का केन्द्र मूलबिन्दु तथा त्रिज्या \(r\) है, और यह दोनों अक्षों के सापेक्ष सममित है। अतः इसका क्षेत्रफल, प्रथम चतुर्थांश में वक्र, \(x\)-अक्ष तथा कोटियों \(x = 0\) और \(x = r\) से घिरे भाग के क्षेत्रफल का 4 गुना है।
प्रथम चतुर्थांश में \(y = \sqrt{r^2 - x^2}\)। अतः
क्षेत्रफल \(= 4\int_0^r \sqrt{r^2 - x^2} \, dx = 4\left[\frac{x}{2}\sqrt{r^2 - x^2} + \frac{r^2}{2}\sin^{-1}\frac{x}{r}\right]_0^r\)
\(= 4\left[\left(\frac{r}{2} \cdot 0 + \frac{r^2}{2}\sin^{-1}1\right) - (0 + 0)\right] = 4 \cdot \frac{r^2}{2} \cdot \frac{\pi}{2} = \pi r^2\)।
अतः वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल \(\pi r^2\) वर्ग इकाई है।

Q7a.en:
Here \(|A| = 2\begin{vmatrix} 2 & -4 \\ 1 & -2 \end{vmatrix} - (-3)\begin{vmatrix} 3 & -4 \\ 1 & -2 \end{vmatrix} + 5\begin{vmatrix} 3 & 2 \\ 1 & 1 \end{vmatrix} = 2(-4 + 4) + 3(-6 + 4) + 5(3 - 2) = 0 - 6 + 5 = -1\).
Since \(|A| \neq 0\), \(A^{-1}\) exists.
The cofactors \(A_{ij}\) of the elements are:
\(A_{11} = (-4 + 4) = 0\), \(A_{12} = -(-6 + 4) = 2\), \(A_{13} = (3 - 2) = 1\)
\(A_{21} = -(6 - 5) = -1\), \(A_{22} = (-4 - 5) = -9\), \(A_{23} = -(2 + 3) = -5\)
\(A_{31} = (12 - 10) = 2\), \(A_{32} = -(-8 - 15) = 23\), \(A_{33} = (4 + 9) = 13\)
So \(\text{adj} A = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & -1 & 2 \\ 2 & -9 & 23 \\ 1 & -5 & 13 \end{bmatrix}\) (the transpose of the matrix of cofactors).
Therefore \(A^{-1} = \frac{1}{|A|}\text{adj} A = \frac{1}{-1}\begin{bmatrix} 0 & -1 & 2 \\ 2 & -9 & 23 \\ 1 & -5 & 13 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & 1 & -2 \\ -2 & 9 & -23 \\ -1 & 5 & -13 \end{bmatrix}\).
(Check: multiplying the matrix \(A\) by this matrix gives \(I\); for example the first row of \(A\) times the first column is \(0 + 6 - 5 = 1\).)

Q8a.en:
**Note:** The English print asks for the cylinder of maximum surface area, while the Hindi print asks for maximum curved surface; the radius comes out as half the cone's radius only for the curved surface, so the working follows the Hindi print.
Let the given cone have base radius \(R\) and height \(H\), and let a right circular cylinder of radius \(r\) and height \(h\) be inscribed in it, with its base on the base of the cone (\(0 < r < R\)).
In the vertical section through the axis, the small triangle above the top of the cylinder (height \(H - h\), half-base \(r\)) is similar to the whole triangle (height \(H\), half-base \(R\)). So
\(\frac{H - h}{H} = \frac{r}{R} \Rightarrow h = \frac{H(R - r)}{R}\).
The curved surface area of the cylinder is
\(S = 2\pi r h = \frac{2\pi H}{R}(Rr - r^2)\).
Differentiating with respect to \(r\):
\(\frac{dS}{dr} = \frac{2\pi H}{R}(R - 2r)\).
For a maximum or minimum, \(\frac{dS}{dr} = 0 \Rightarrow R - 2r = 0 \Rightarrow r = \frac{R}{2}\).
Again, \(\frac{d^2S}{dr^2} = \frac{2\pi H}{R}(-2) = -\frac{4\pi H}{R} < 0\), so \(S\) is maximum at \(r = \frac{R}{2}\).
Hence the radius of the inscribed right circular cylinder of greatest curved surface is half the radius of the cone. Hence proved.
Q8a.hi:
**टिप्पणी:** अंग्रेज़ी प्रश्न में महत्तम पृष्ठ क्षेत्रफल वाला बेलन पूछा गया है, जबकि हिंदी प्रश्न में महत्तम वक्र पृष्ठ वाला; बेलन की त्रिज्या शंकु की त्रिज्या की आधी केवल वक्र पृष्ठ के लिए आती है, अतः हल हिंदी प्रश्न के अनुसार किया गया है।
माना दिए गए शंकु के आधार की त्रिज्या \(R\) तथा ऊँचाई \(H\) है, और इसके अंतर्गत \(r\) त्रिज्या तथा \(h\) ऊँचाई का एक लम्ब वृत्तीय बेलन बना है, जिसका आधार शंकु के आधार पर है (\(0 < r < R\))।
अक्ष से होकर जाने वाले ऊर्ध्वाधर परिच्छेद में, बेलन के ऊपरी तल के ऊपर का छोटा त्रिभुज (ऊँचाई \(H - h\), आधी भुजा \(r\)) पूरे त्रिभुज (ऊँचाई \(H\), आधी भुजा \(R\)) के समरूप है। अतः
\(\frac{H - h}{H} = \frac{r}{R} \Rightarrow h = \frac{H(R - r)}{R}\)।
बेलन का वक्र पृष्ठ
\(S = 2\pi r h = \frac{2\pi H}{R}(Rr - r^2)\)।
\(r\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर:
\(\frac{dS}{dr} = \frac{2\pi H}{R}(R - 2r)\)।
उच्चिष्ठ अथवा निम्निष्ठ के लिए \(\frac{dS}{dr} = 0 \Rightarrow R - 2r = 0 \Rightarrow r = \frac{R}{2}\)।
पुनः \(\frac{d^2S}{dr^2} = \frac{2\pi H}{R}(-2) = -\frac{4\pi H}{R} < 0\), अतः \(r = \frac{R}{2}\) पर \(S\) महत्तम है।
अतः शंकु के अंतर्गत महत्तम वक्र पृष्ठ वाले लम्ब वृत्तीय बेलन की त्रिज्या शंकु की त्रिज्या की आधी होती है। इति सिद्धम्।

Q8b.en:
Let \(I = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin x \, dx\) ...(1)
Using \(\int_0^a f(x) \, dx = \int_0^a f(a - x) \, dx\):
\(I = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - x\right) dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \cos x \, dx\) ...(2)
Adding (1) and (2):
\(2I = \int_0^{\pi/2} (\log \sin x + \log \cos x) \, dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log(\sin x \cos x) \, dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log\left(\frac{\sin 2x}{2}\right) dx\)
\(= \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin 2x \, dx - \int_0^{\pi/2} \log 2 \, dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin 2x \, dx - \frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\) ...(3)
In \(I_1 = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin 2x \, dx\), put \(2x = t\), so \(dx = \frac{dt}{2}\); when \(x = 0\), \(t = 0\) and when \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\), \(t = \pi\):
\(I_1 = \frac{1}{2}\int_0^{\pi} \log \sin t \, dt\).
Since \(\log \sin(\pi - t) = \log \sin t\), using \(\int_0^{2a} f(t) \, dt = 2\int_0^a f(t) \, dt\):
\(I_1 = \frac{1}{2} \cdot 2\int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin t \, dt = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin x \, dx = I\).
Putting this in (3): \(2I = I - \frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\), so
\(I = -\frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\).
So \(\int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin x \, dx = -\frac{\pi}{2}\log 2 = \frac{\pi}{2}\log\frac{1}{2}\).
Q8b.hi:
माना \(I = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin x \, dx\) ...(1)
गुणधर्म \(\int_0^a f(x) \, dx = \int_0^a f(a - x) \, dx\) से:
\(I = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - x\right) dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \cos x \, dx\) ...(2)
(1) तथा (2) को जोड़ने पर:
\(2I = \int_0^{\pi/2} (\log \sin x + \log \cos x) \, dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log(\sin x \cos x) \, dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log\left(\frac{\sin 2x}{2}\right) dx\)
\(= \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin 2x \, dx - \int_0^{\pi/2} \log 2 \, dx = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin 2x \, dx - \frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\) ...(3)
\(I_1 = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin 2x \, dx\) में \(2x = t\) रखने पर \(dx = \frac{dt}{2}\); जब \(x = 0\), \(t = 0\) तथा जब \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\), \(t = \pi\):
\(I_1 = \frac{1}{2}\int_0^{\pi} \log \sin t \, dt\)।
चूँकि \(\log \sin(\pi - t) = \log \sin t\), अतः गुणधर्म \(\int_0^{2a} f(t) \, dt = 2\int_0^a f(t) \, dt\) से:
\(I_1 = \frac{1}{2} \cdot 2\int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin t \, dt = \int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin x \, dx = I\)।
इसे (3) में रखने पर: \(2I = I - \frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\), अतः
\(I = -\frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\)।
अतः \(\int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin x \, dx = -\frac{\pi}{2}\log 2 = \frac{\pi}{2}\log\frac{1}{2}\)।

Q9a.en:
Take \(a, b > 0\). Let \(I = \int_0^{\pi} \frac{x \, dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\) ...(1)
Using \(\int_0^a f(x) \, dx = \int_0^a f(a - x) \, dx\), and \(\cos^2(\pi - x) = \cos^2 x\), \(\sin^2(\pi - x) = \sin^2 x\):
\(I = \int_0^{\pi} \frac{(\pi - x) \, dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\) ...(2)
Adding (1) and (2):
\(2I = \pi\int_0^{\pi} \frac{dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\).
The integrand is unchanged when \(x\) is replaced by \(\pi - x\), so by \(\int_0^{2a} f(x) \, dx = 2\int_0^a f(x) \, dx\):
\(2I = 2\pi\int_0^{\pi/2} \frac{dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\), that is \(I = \pi\int_0^{\pi/2} \frac{dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\).
Dividing numerator and denominator by \(\cos^2 x\):
\(I = \pi\int_0^{\pi/2} \frac{\sec^2 x \, dx}{a^2 + b^2\tan^2 x}\).
Put \(\tan x = t\), so \(\sec^2 x \, dx = dt\); when \(x = 0\), \(t = 0\) and when \(x \to \frac{\pi}{2}\), \(t \to \infty\):
\(I = \pi\int_0^{\infty} \frac{dt}{a^2 + b^2t^2} = \frac{\pi}{b^2}\int_0^{\infty} \frac{dt}{\left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^2 + t^2} = \frac{\pi}{b^2} \cdot \frac{b}{a}\left[\tan^{-1}\frac{bt}{a}\right]_0^{\infty}\)
\(= \frac{\pi}{ab}\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - 0\right) = \frac{\pi^2}{2ab}\).
So the value is \(\frac{\pi^2}{2ab}\).
Q9a.hi:
माना \(a, b > 0\) तथा \(I = \int_0^{\pi} \frac{x \, dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\) ...(1)
गुणधर्म \(\int_0^a f(x) \, dx = \int_0^a f(a - x) \, dx\) से, तथा \(\cos^2(\pi - x) = \cos^2 x\), \(\sin^2(\pi - x) = \sin^2 x\) होने से:
\(I = \int_0^{\pi} \frac{(\pi - x) \, dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\) ...(2)
(1) तथा (2) को जोड़ने पर:
\(2I = \pi\int_0^{\pi} \frac{dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\)।
\(x\) के स्थान पर \(\pi - x\) रखने पर समाकल्य अपरिवर्तित रहता है, अतः गुणधर्म \(\int_0^{2a} f(x) \, dx = 2\int_0^a f(x) \, dx\) से:
\(2I = 2\pi\int_0^{\pi/2} \frac{dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\), अर्थात् \(I = \pi\int_0^{\pi/2} \frac{dx}{a^2\cos^2 x + b^2\sin^2 x}\)।
अंश और हर को \(\cos^2 x\) से भाग देने पर:
\(I = \pi\int_0^{\pi/2} \frac{\sec^2 x \, dx}{a^2 + b^2\tan^2 x}\)।
\(\tan x = t\) रखने पर \(\sec^2 x \, dx = dt\); जब \(x = 0\), \(t = 0\) तथा जब \(x \to \frac{\pi}{2}\), \(t \to \infty\):
\(I = \pi\int_0^{\infty} \frac{dt}{a^2 + b^2t^2} = \frac{\pi}{b^2}\int_0^{\infty} \frac{dt}{\left(\frac{a}{b}\right)^2 + t^2} = \frac{\pi}{b^2} \cdot \frac{b}{a}\left[\tan^{-1}\frac{bt}{a}\right]_0^{\infty}\)
\(= \frac{\pi}{ab}\left(\frac{\pi}{2} - 0\right) = \frac{\pi^2}{2ab}\)।
अतः अभीष्ट मान \(\frac{\pi^2}{2ab}\) है।

Q9b.en:
Given \(y = \sin^{-1}x\). Differentiating with respect to \(x\):
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}\), so \(\sqrt{1 - x^2}\,\frac{dy}{dx} = 1\).
Differentiating again with respect to \(x\) (product rule):
\(\sqrt{1 - x^2}\,\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} + \frac{dy}{dx} \cdot \frac{-2x}{2\sqrt{1 - x^2}} = 0\), that is \(\sqrt{1 - x^2}\,\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - \frac{x}{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}\,\frac{dy}{dx} = 0\).
Multiplying by \(\sqrt{1 - x^2}\):
\((1 - x^2)\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - x\frac{dy}{dx} = 0\). Hence shown.
Q9b.hi:
दिया है \(y = \sin^{-1}x\)। \(x\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर:
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}\), अतः \(\sqrt{1 - x^2}\,\frac{dy}{dx} = 1\)।
पुनः \(x\) के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर (गुणनफल नियम से):
\(\sqrt{1 - x^2}\,\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} + \frac{dy}{dx} \cdot \frac{-2x}{2\sqrt{1 - x^2}} = 0\), अर्थात् \(\sqrt{1 - x^2}\,\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - \frac{x}{\sqrt{1 - x^2}}\,\frac{dy}{dx} = 0\)।
\(\sqrt{1 - x^2}\) से गुणा करने पर:
\((1 - x^2)\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} - x\frac{dy}{dx} = 0\)। इति सिद्धम्।
